analogy.rationale: Adenosine receptors are Gi/Gs-coupled GPCRs whose expression is low in most of these cell lines, so agonists produce little transcriptional change; the closest reference classes are other purinergic/adenosine receptor ligands and GPCR antagonists, with cAMP-pathway modulators as weaker analogs.
